author: feenberg
body:
On Mon, 3 Aug 2026, David Trimmer wrote:

> DTrim99 left a comment (PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim#1116)
>
> Two questions:
>
> 1. Does TaxAct's federal return for this record include the 10% penalty
>    on Schedule 2, line 8? Only the 1040ME made it into the upload ?
>    could you add the federal 1040? If TA coded the 1099-R as an early
>    distribution, denying the Maine deduction is internally coherent on
>    their side, and the disagreement is really about the federal
>    treatment of `pensions` for a young filer, not about Maine.

I didn't save the federal return. Taxsim doesn't penalize pensions for 
early distribution, that would account for my noticing this return.


> 2. What convention should apply? Since TAXSIM's `pensions` input doesn't
>    carry a distribution code, the choice seems to be: treat pension
>    income as penalty-free at every age (both engines' current federal
>    behavior, which then implies the Maine deduction), or treat under-59?
>    pensions as penalized (which would add ~$8,358 of federal tax *and*
>    deny the Maine deduction). Mixing the two ? no federal penalty but
>    state denial ? doesn't correspond to any single consistent return.

I am going to discuss this with Pavel on our next call. Perhaps you should 
join us. Do you think that would be a good idea? Have you seen 
https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim/issues/1119

Dan
